# Problem 0

## Setting up 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# setting up tidyverse library
library(tidyverse)

# setting chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

# setting minimal theme and legend position
theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

# setting continuous scales to viridis
options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

# setting discrete color scale to viridis
scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d

# setting discrete fill scale to viridis
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```
